checks.name: finding 1: banner and contentinfo inside article do not block site banner, main, or footer
checks.code: const masthead = document.getElementById('site-masthead'); const footer = document.getElementById('site-footer'); const main = document.getElementById('primary-area'); if (!masthead || !footer || !main) return false; return masthead.getAttribute('role') === 'banner' && footer.getAttribute('role') === 'contentinfo' && main.getAttribute('role') === 'main';

checks.name: finding 2: candidate footer containing nav is recognized as contentinfo
checks.code: const footer = document.getElementById('site-footer'); if (!footer) return false; const innerNav = footer.querySelector('nav'); return Boolean(innerNav) && footer.getAttribute('role') === 'contentinfo';
